detail.longDescription: I have a task to build GitHub custom image runners. I already have my custom hardened images. But I didn't find any option in GitHub enterprise to create a runner using my hardened image. What is the best way to do it? Do I first need to create a run with GitHub available images? Create a snapshot of it? Customize it and create my own image out of it? But that way, it is reverse engineering. Has anyone worked on it before? In this era of AI, I am requesting real humans. Already tried: creating a runner with GitHub images. but that is the solution, I don't want. I already have hardened images.
